mapper.select: select g.goods_id, g.goods_name, g.image_url, g.origin_price, a.group_price, g.spec_summary, g.after_sale_policy, g.recommend_reason, g.not_suitable_for, a.activity_id, a.team_size, timestampdiff(second, now(), a.end_time) as remaining_seconds from guide_goods g left join group_activity a on a.goods_id = g.goods_id and a.enabled = 1 and a.start_time <= now() and a.end_time > now() where g.enabled = 1 order by g.sort_order asc, g.id asc limit 1

select g.goods_id, g.goods_name, g.image_url, g.origin_price, a.group_price, g.spec_summary, g.after_sale_policy, g.recommend_reason, g.not_suitable_for, a.activity_id, a.team_size, timestampdiff(second, now(), a.end_time) as remaining_seconds from guide_goods g left join group_activity a on a.goods_id = g.goods_id and a.enabled = 1 and a.start_time <= now() and a.end_time > now() where g.enabled = 1 and g.goods_id = #{goodsId} order by a.start_time desc, a.id desc limit 1
